summary: Iteration 11 (AI SCRIPT REVIEW/EDIT flows across Series + Batch, FULL STACK, REELS_MOCK=0 real generation) — 10/10 backend pytest cases PASS and both frontend flows verified end-to-end against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as the admin (russngina@gmail.com). BACKEND: POST /api/reels/batch/scripts returns {scripts:[{topic,script,word_count}]} 1:1 with the topics (verified with 2 real topics, word_count>0, non-empty scripts); empty topics -> 400 'At least one topic is required'; whitespace-only topics -> 400; >12 topics (sent 13) -> 400 with '12' in the message; unauthenticated -> 401; admin bypasses the BYOK/subscription gate. POST /api/reels/batch with scripts:[{topic,script}] persists the EXACT reviewed text — verified by GET /api/reels/{id} on each of the 2 created reels: reel.script matches the REVIEWED_SCRIPT_* marker verbatim (no AI rewrite), reel.topic matches, title starts with the topic. POST /api/series/{id}/episode/script returns {script, word_count, episode_number} continuity draft and does NOT create a reel or bump series.episode_count (verified with before/after snapshots); wrong series_id -> 404; unauthenticated -> 401. POST /api/series/{id}/episode with a script field creates one reel with series_id set, episode_number bumped, valid non-stuck status (queued|scripting|voicing|captioning|rendering|uploading|ready|scheduled), and GET /api/reels/{id} returns the reviewed script VERBATIM — even after a 2s pipeline grace window, the pre-supplied script is NOT overwritten by the background pipeline (server.py:684-699 correctly skips generate_series_script when reel.script is present). FRONTEND (Series review, /series/{id}): admin logged in via /auth, navigated to the seeded TEST_UI_Series detail — the CREATE EPISODE 1 card shows episode-topic-input, episode-write-script-button ('Write episode 1 script') and create-episode-button ('Generate episode 1') which is aria-disabled='true' BEFORE any script is drafted. Tapping episode-write-script-button drafted a 229-char continuity script (real AI, ~7s) and populated episode-script-input; create-episode-button then flipped to aria-disabled=None (enabled) and the button label became 'Rewrite episode 1 script' (per requirement). Edited the draft to a unique UI marker 'REVIEWED_UI_EDIT_MARKER_XYZ …', tapped Generate episode 1, and it navigated to /reel/{new_id}; the reel screen shows the 'BUILDING YOUR REEL' progress card (55% Aligning captions). Confirmed via authenticated GET /api/reels/{new_id} that reel.script == 'REVIEWED_UI_EDIT_MARKER_XYZ — this text was typed in the UI and should be persisted verbatim.' EXACTLY (no AI overwrite), series_id matches, and status reached 'ready'. FRONTEND (Batch review, /batch): entered two topics one-per-line in batch-topics-input ('Why cats purr' + '3 tiny habits that compound'); primary CTA correctly rendered as batch-write-scripts-button labeled 'Write 2 scripts' (batch-generate-button NOT present at this stage). Tapping it drafted both scripts (~10s real AI); batch-script-input-0 and batch-script-input-1 both appeared populated (draft 0 = 484 chars, cats-purring copy). CTA correctly switched to batch-generate-button labeled 'Generate 2 reels' (batch-write-scripts-button no longer present). Adding a THIRD line to the topics text correctly cleared drafts (both batch-script-input-N gone) and reverted the CTA back to batch-write-scripts-button labeled 'Write 3 scripts' — invalidation-on-topic-edit works as designed (batch.tsx:53 useEffect). Edited batch-script-input-0 to a marker string, tapped batch-generate-button — outbound POST to /api/reels/batch was captured via page.route intercept and confirmed the request body contains the scripts array AND the exact UI-edited marker text ('UI_BATCH_EDIT_MARKER_ALPHA — reviewed & edited in the UI.'), then the app navigated to /library as expected. No react-native red screens, no unhandled JS errors (only pre-existing pointerEvents/expo-notifications warnings).

issues: On a hard reload of /series/{id}, load() runs before the auth token has been attached to the api client, so the very first GET /api/series/{id} returns 401 and the red 'Couldn't load this series.' errorBox is briefly rendered (visible on the first render, see /tmp/it11_series_pre.png). It self-heals on the next focus/interval tick once the token is set. Consider: (a) awaiting the auth-hydrated boolean before calling load(), or (b) suppressing the error on 401 while auth is still initialising. Not blocking — the flow works — but it looks broken on cold-load.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing React 19 warning `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` — not new in this iteration, appears on nearly every screen.
Pre-existing warning `[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web` — web-preview limitation only, safe on native.

action_items: OPTIONAL POLISH: In /app/frontend/app/series/[id].tsx `load()` (line 33-42), skip the fetch (or don't render the errorBox for 401) while useAuth() is still hydrating the token from SecureStore. Right now the red 'Couldn't load this series.' banner flashes on cold navigation to /series/{id} before disappearing on the next tick.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1108-1135 (POST /reels/batch/scripts) — Correctly gates on (BYOK OR subscribed OR admin), validates topics count (1..12) BEFORE calling the LLM, moderates topics, runs asyncio.gather() with return_exceptions=True and re-raises the first LLM error as a friendly 402 for budget/key or 500 otherwise. Good.

server.py:1078-1099 (POST /reels/batch) — Pairs reviewed scripts to topics 1:1 by exact topic-string match (script_map keyed on stripped topic). Correct edge case: if a topic in `topics` is not present in `scripts`, that reel is created with script=None and the pipeline auto-generates. If a script is present, moderate_text(*script_map.values()) also moderates the reviewed script (important — user could paste anything). build_reel_doc(..., script=script,...) plumbs it through.

server.py:684-699 (run_pipeline) — Correctly checks `if not script:` before generating; when a reviewed script was pre-supplied via /reels/batch or /series/{id}/episode, the pipeline SKIPS the AI script stage and jumps to voicing. Verified end-to-end: the UI-typed marker text ends up on disk and in the final reel doc verbatim, unmodified.

server.py:1268-1293 (POST /series/{id}/episode/script) — Draft-only endpoint: correctly does NOT insert into db.reels and does NOT bump series.episode_count. It DOES call enforce_quota(user), which is arguably too strict (a script draft doesn't consume real generation credits on the shared pool, only ~1 chat completion). For the admin the quota check is a no-op via is_admin, but for a free-tier user near their 3-reel limit this could refuse to even DRAFT the script. Consider dropping enforce_quota() from the /script and /episode/script endpoints and enforcing only at the real create endpoints (server.py:999-1014 has the same choice for /api/script). Not a bug per this iteration's scope, just an ergonomics note.

server.py:1296-1320 (POST /series/{id}/episode) — Correctly plumbs req.script through build_reel_doc, consumes quota AFTER insert, updates series.episode_count and updated_at, and kicks off run_pipeline. Non-blocking async task. Good.
server.py:1301 — moderate_text(req.topic, req.script) is called on the reviewed script before insert — good, prevents users from bypassing moderation by editing the draft.

batch.tsx:53 — `useEffect(() => { setDrafts([]); }, [topicsText, seconds]);` cleanly invalidates the drafts whenever the user edits the topics or changes the target length. This means the CTA always re-drafts on topic changes, preventing stale script/topic mismatches on submit. Verified in UI.

batch.tsx:229-247 — The CTA correctly toggles between batch-write-scripts-button (when drafts.length===0) and batch-generate-button (when drafts.length>0). Both are inside KeyboardStickyView so they float above the keyboard on mobile.
series/[id].tsx:190 — `disabled={!script.trim()}` on the PrimaryButton correctly enforces 'no build without a reviewed script'. Verified aria-disabled='true' → None transition on the web preview.
series/[id].tsx:33-42 — `load()` doesn't gate on `user` being ready, so on cold navigate the first fetch races with auth hydration and returns 401 → flashes the error banner. See design_issues above.
